description: Adapter functions to map remote API schemas into internal models for BrainBoost LMS. Includes functions for adapting users, courses, categories, enrollments, and progress, with utility functions for mapping dummy JSON data.

methods.name: safeId
methods.description: Utility function to extract a consistent 'id' field from various remote API objects.

methods.name: adaptUser
methods.description: Adapts remote user schema into internal user model.

methods.name: adaptCourse
methods.description: Adapts remote course schema into internal course model.

methods.name: mapCategoryListFromDummyJSON
methods.description: Maps array of category names to internal category models with slugified IDs and colors.

methods.name: mapProductListFromDummyJSON
methods.description: Maps payload of products to internal course list with pagination info.

methods.name: mapProductFromDummyJSON
methods.description: Maps a single dummy product object to internal course model.

methods.name: adaptCategory
methods.description: Adapts remote category schema into internal category model.

methods.name: adaptEnrollment
methods.description: Adapts remote enrollment schema into internal enrollment model.

methods.name: adaptProgress
methods.description: Adapts remote progress schema into internal progress model.
